extraction.name: CommonCatalog
extraction.description: A dataset of approximately 70 million Creative-Commons-licensed images paired with high-quality synthetic captions. The captions were generated using a pre-trained BLIP-2 model to address the lack of captions in open-licensed images.
extraction.creator: Aaron Gokaslan, A. Feder Cooper, Jasmine Collins, Landan Seguin, Austin Jacobson, Mihir Patel, Jonathan Frankle, Cory Stephenson, Volodymyr Kuleshov
extraction.rai:dataCollection: The authors sourced Creative-Commons images from the existing YFCC100M dataset, excluded images with non-derivative (ND) licenses, and used a pre-trained BLIP-2 OPT2.5B model to generate synthetic captions for the images.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionMissingData: The raw images rarely had the necessary alt-text captions, so the authors handled this missing data by synthesizing high-quality captions using the BLIP-2 OPT2.5B model.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: The raw data consists of Creative-Commons images from the YFCC100M dataset, as well as images from the LAION-2B dataset used for comparison and training subsets.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Synthetic caption generation using a pre-trained generative model (a process the authors term 'telephoning') to create labels for unlabeled images.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: The dataset relies on older images from YFCC100M, making it less current than other datasets, and suffers from data incompleteness and scarcity issues.
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: The dataset addresses legal and social implications surrounding copyright in generative AI by providing a fully open-licensed alternative for training.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: The dataset is used for training text-to-image latent diffusion models.
extraction.rai:dataImputationProtocol: Missing captions for the images were filled by generating synthetic captions using a pre-trained BLIP-2 model.

rai:dataLimitations.evidence: An issue, which we do not address, is that the YFCC100M data is about a decade old; its CC images are not as current as those in LAION-2B.

rai:dataSocialImpact.evidence: We note that several recent works study copyright. [...] To the best of our knowledge, no prior open work attempts to train T2I models on only open-licensed data.

rai:dataUseCases.evidence: In this paper, we train the family of CommonCanvas text-to-image latent diffusion models on only Creative-Commons images and synthetic captions.
